slices.focus: Caleb and Lena formalize caregiving for Dorothy: Caleb takes over Friday medical transport to protect Lena's bandwidth and their marriage
slices.summary: After Dorothy refuses another medical appointment and Lena's schedule keeps getting disrupted, Caleb and Lena have a formal planning session. They agree Caleb will handle all Friday medical transport for his mother, creating clear ownership of caregiving tasks and protecting their evenings from constant negotiation.
open_loops: Tell Dorothy about the new Friday arrangement as a settled routine
Build a simple one-page Friday sheet (meds, appointment time, pickup, questions)
Create a decompression ritual (truck time, breakfast taco stop) after Friday appointments
decisions: Caleb and Lena formally agreed that Caleb would handle all of Dorothy's Friday medical transport to reduce the recurring
